rationale: Optimal dispatch minimizes diesel cost by using the battery's initial 18 MWh SOC to displace diesel. Charging 4 MW in t1 (SOC 18→21.8) creates headroom for discharging 12 MW in t3 (SOC 19.58→6.24), while discharging 2 MW in t2. Net battery output is 10 MWh (electrical), reducing diesel from 121 MWh (no battery) to 111 MWh, saving $850.
